title: When pressing Enter on a `LineEdit` that's hidden afterwards, both `focus_exited` and `text_submitted` signals are emitted at the same time, causing duplicate calls in `EditorPropertyNodePath`
body:
### Tested versions

master [893cf5cbfe789ae67c9389708e1428141bb39b18]
v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev3 - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 (Apple9) - Apple M4 (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Related to #121678 but not same issue, mentioned in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122624#issuecomment-5361407249

This causes it:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fe3d682f85da7fd3aa79aa8b7674caf2a444b3ca/editor/inspector/editor_properties.cpp#L3375-L3376

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fe3d682f85da7fd3aa79aa8b7674caf2a444b3ca/editor/inspector/editor_properties.cpp#L3141-L3151

Hiding a `Control` node drops focus of that node and therefore sends the `focus_exited` signal, which is correct and expected. But since `_text_submitted` hides the `LineEdit`, `_text_submitted` will be called yet again by `_accept_text` (luckily it doesn't get called again because it would already be hidden at that time otherwise the stack would overflow).

Since the behavior of the signal is correct, I think the correct fix would be to address the duplicate calls there instead. The intention here is that the value should be saved even when focus is exited either way, therefore I think everything can be moved over to `_accept_text`, using the `edit->get_text()` property instead of the `text` local parameter, and the separate `text_submitted` call can be set to just `release_focus()`. Idk if a warning about unused parameter would be emitted from it, though. If it does, though, then it can be probably covered up, I guess.

If there's anything else that also hides the `LineEdit` after `text_submitted` and that has a `focus_exited` method that calls the `text_submitted` method, then that should be addressed, too. I can't think of any off the top of my head, though.

### Steps to reproduce

(The steps and MRP are the same as in #121678, but the outcome to look for is different)

Have a `Node` with a script that exports a `Node` variable. Click on the kebab dropdown and choose `Edit`. Then press Enter (even empty node names are considered invalid). The toast should appear twice (saying `(2)` at the end) instead of once, because it called `_node_selected` twice.

Alternatively, you can also enter a valid value like `.` and see that `set node` appears in the Output twice instead of once, but this is harder to notice in general.
